Which of your products is best for that, and why is it a good fit?
Our most popular starting unit is the 222x2x11 Spice Rack Drawer. It is designed to fit standard 10.6" deep upper cabinets and holds up to 30 standard spice jars (or up to 60 stacked half-size jars) in a narrow width of under 7 inches.
It is a great choice because of its heavy-duty build and full-extension design. The smooth, 100 lb-rated steel ball-bearing slides pull the entire drawer completely out of your cabinet so you can see every single label from front to back without reaching into dark corners or knocking over bottles. Plus, our patented Flex-Side bands adapt to odd-shaped jars while keeping everything securely in place.
We have displayed some of our top spice and storage drawers for you to explore. Would you like to check if the 222x2x11 matches your specific cabinet measurements, or are you looking to store larger jars and oil bottles?
